tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: A valid copy of the Registered Man Power Agency with labour Licence with validity (From Department of Labour, GOK)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
A valid copy of the ESI Certificate with challan
Latest copy of the Income Tax return for financial year 2025-26 (Assesment year 2026-27)
Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate with previous 3 months EPF paid challan

Clearance certificate of previous year shall be obtained from competent authority not below the rank of for ESI Deputy Director, Sub Regional offce, for EPF Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner Regional Office or Digitally Paid Challans (EPF & ESI) of Previous Year. (12 months)
Amount quated and Price Break up details (total for 12 months)

Scanned signature of the bidder along with phone number / authorised representative in case of a firm or company, to be attached while uploading the bid documents. Also in case of authorised representative, scanned copy of power of attorney should be uploaded & the original should be produced at the time of opening of tender

The contractor should quote the rates considering previlling minimum wages as per Karnataka Minimum wages act 1954 and L.D 411 L.W.A 2023 Dated . 22-05-2026, 106 LWA 2021 Dated 28-07-2022. In case of quoted rates are less then minimum wages will be liable for rejection.

If there is more than one number of eligible L1 bidders, then bidder selection will be done by lottery process at Division office level and the decision of the tender inviting authority is final in this regard.

The intending bidder should have achieved a minimum financial turnover of not less than Amount put to tender i.e. for Rs. 17.97 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last 5 years reckoned back from 2026-27 (turnover during 2021-22 to 2025-26 only will be considered) duly updating the financial turnover at 10% per year to bring it to the price level of financial year in which the tenders are invited per annum upto 2025-26. Audited profit and loss statement (with year wise turnover statement) certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant with Compulsory UID number along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the two years indicated above shall be furnished

Liquid Assets and or availability of cridet facilities of not less than Rs. 5.39 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letters of credit / certificate from banks) for meeting the fund requirements etc., (usavaly the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in peak construction period)

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Tender capacity ( Ax Nx 2.5- B ) where A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years(2021-22 to 2025-26) (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value, at 2025-26 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1/12 years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
